title: Prerequisites above their dependents in queue order
goal: With workItems.order queue, the generated ledger never lists a record above an open record of its group that it depends on
acceptance: An open prerequisite chain is listed just above its first dependent, whatever its priority or lane
Records that wait on nothing keep the priority order; the build is deterministic
Both BACKLOG-RULES copies, CHANGELOG 8.2.0 and an APPLY reconcile step
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Judged 2026-11-13 from F-065: 1 h for one ordering pass, a test, rules and a release; implementation done, review and release remaining. Estimate, not a measurement.
